response.name: Doraemon Movies
response.overview: The series revolves around an earless robotic cat named Doraemon, who travels back in time from the 22nd century to aid a boy named Nobita Nobi.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the New Steel Troops: Winged Angels
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太と鉄人兵団 ～はばたけ 天使たち～
parts.overview: Nobita and Doraemon find a giant robot in pieces which they later assemble. It turns out to be a destructive weapon and the gang must save Earth from an imminent invasion.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Green Giant Legend
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と緑の巨人伝
parts.overview: A sapling Nobita discovers is turned into a plant-boy with help from Doraemon, and becomes Earth's only hope at passing judgment from the dryadic aliens of the Green Planet.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's New Great Adventure Into the Underworld - The Seven Magic Users
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の新魔界大冒険 〜7人の魔法使い〜
parts.overview: Nobita wishes the world into a magic-reliant one with Doraemon's Moshimo-Box, and, along with his friends, must stop an asteroid from hitting the planet with help from a sorcerer-in-training.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Battle of the Mermaid King
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の人魚大海戦
parts.overview: Nobita, Doraemon, and the rest must come to the aid of mermaid princess Sophia, whose undersea kingdom is suffering under the weight of a war. Their only hope lies in a mythical sword from the planet Aqua...

parts.title: Doraemon: The New Record of Nobita's Spaceblazer
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の宇宙開拓史
parts.overview: Nobita finds a passage to a spaceship in another dimension. With their new friends, he and Doraemon fight the cruel leader of an exploited planet.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Island of Miracles – Animal Adventure
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と奇跡の島 ～アニマル アドベンチャー～
parts.overview: Nobita and Doraemon use time tree Mochi and catch a big bird, which has been extinct for 500 years ago. To protect the animal, Nobita and Doraemon go to Beremon Island, overseen by a golden beetle named Herakles.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Dinosaur
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の恐竜
parts.overview: When Suneo does not show Nobita the fossil of a dinosaur claw, he takes up a challenge to find a dinosaur. He digs up a hillside and finds an egg, which later hatches and becomes a dinosaur.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Kingdom of Clouds
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と雲の王国
parts.overview: Nobita, after wondering if Heaven truly exists, asks for Doraemon to take him there. When his robot pal suggests that they make their own Heaven, Nobita enlists Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo to help, but a war breaks out between two islands in the clouds that could have terrible environmental consequences if Nobita and Doraemon don't bring peace in time!

parts.title: Doraemon: The Record of Nobita's Parallel Journey to the West
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のパラレル西遊記
parts.overview: As Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo are auditioning for a role in their school's play based on "Journey to the West", the coveted role of Son Goku is hotly contested. After suggesting that the real Great Sage Equal to Heaven should play himself, knowing that the story is only a legend, Nobita and Doraemon go back in time to find their own fake Monkey King, but arrive in present day with the story's demons having taken over the world. The only way for things to go back to normal is for Nobita and pals to reenact the tale...for real!

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Animal Planet
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とアニマル惑星
parts.overview: Nobita and his friends get transported to an animal planet after a mysterious pink fog appears inside his house. They work together with the natives to find the origin of the fog.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Secret Gadget Museum
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のひみつ道具博物館
parts.overview: Doraemon and his friends travel to the 22nd century to look for his golden bell, which was stolen by a notorious thief called Kaito DX.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita in the Wan-Nyan Spacetime Odyssey
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のワンニャン時空伝
parts.overview: Nobita, believing he and Doraemon had done a good deed by saving stray cats and dogs and sending them back in time by 300 million years, discover that the usage of Doraemon's Ray of Evolution had created a cat-and-dog-person society equal to Nobita's time. When an asteroid attack is set to hit the city, Nobita and his friends must save Doraemon and ease tensions between the two sides.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Legend of the Sun King
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の太陽王伝説
parts.overview: Doraemon and its friends open a hole in the time and they're travel to the Country of Mayana, a lost Mayan civilization in the jungle.

parts.title: Doraemon: New Nobita's Great Demon - Peko and the Exploration Party of Five
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の大魔境 ～ペコと5人の探検隊～
parts.overview: Nobita is followed by a stray dog on his way home and decides to help it find its original owner with the help of Doraemon. They find out that the dog is actually a prince in its homeland in Africa.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Dinosaur
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の恐竜2006
parts.overview: After bringing a fossilized egg back to life with the Time Cloth, Nobita finds himself the owner of a baby dinosaur. Everything is fine until it grows up. Nobita and friends use Doraemon's time machine to return it back to its own time.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Haunts of Evil
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の大魔境
parts.overview: Nobita and Doraemon venture to the Heavy Smokers Forest in the Congo, where they find a stray dog and a giant statue. After discovering that they are wanted for trespassing on isolated kingdom land, Nobita and the rest must utilize the power of the mysterious statue to prove their worth.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Winged Braves
parts.original_title: のび太と翼の勇者たち
parts.overview: Doraemon and his friends have to rescue the people of Birdopia from the wrongdoing of vengeful former bird troopers before they unleash a wicked ancient dragon.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の海底鬼岩城
parts.overview: Nobita and his friends under the waters of the Pacific Ocean. Gian and Suneo take Doraemon's underwater vehicle and travel through the Atlantic Ocean, trying to find a treasure ship.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Galaxy Super-express
parts.original_title: ドラえもん のび太と銀河超特急
parts.overview: Doraemon went missing for 3 days. But it turns out later that he went to the 22nd century to buy a mystery galactic express train ticket whose destination is a secret until the passengers arrive there and see for themselves.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Spiral City
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のねじ巻き都市冒険記
parts.overview: When Doraemon and Nobita win a tiny planet through a lottery, they make use of a screw to bring several toys to life and create a toy town.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Dorabian Nights
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のドラビアンナイト
parts.overview: Shizuka ends up in the fantasy world of the 'Arabian Nights' story. However, Doraemon, Nobita, Suneo, and Jyaian must find her from the imaginary Middle East and bring her back to the real life.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Knights on Dinosaurs
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と竜の騎士
parts.overview: Nobita tries to prove to Doraemon and his friends that dinosaurs are still alive, and, after finding an underground cave, discovers a hollow earth civilization of knights and saurian steeds that Suneo must be rescued from.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Windmasters
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とふしぎ風使い
parts.overview: After a typhoon hits Nobita's town, he and Doraemon discover a wind sprite who, with some help from Doraemon's 22nd-century tech, takes them and their friends to a fantastic world of wind and storm people. But the wind sprite, named Fuuko by Nobita, had brought them to her world for a reason, as her peoples' gods are battling, and Suneo might be a key player in their feud.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure in the South Seas
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の南海大冒険
parts.overview: Nobita coaxes his friends to join him for a treasure hunt but an eerie event transports them to the past. However, their hunt for treasure is not easy as they come face-to-face with pirates.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Robot Kingdom
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とロボット王国
parts.overview: Nobita, Doraemon, and the rest travel to the far future, on an inhabited planet where humans and robots coexist. The Empress of the Robot Kingdom is plotting to strip the robot inhabitants of their emotions, so it's up to Nobita and his friends to stop the plan, while also helping a robot boy named Poko from getting caught in the middle.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita Drifts in the Universe
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙漂流記
parts.overview: Nobita and his friends embark on a rescue mission to save Gian and Suneo, whom, after playing one of Doraemon's futuristic video games, are held captive by an evil alien force.

parts.title: Doraemon: The Record of Nobita, Spaceblazer
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙開拓史
parts.overview: Lopple and Chammy, two runaway aliens, recruit Doraemon and Nobita to help save their planet from destruction.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure in the World of Magic
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の魔界大冒険
parts.overview: Nobita, currently obsessed with fantasy fiction, wishes upon Doraemon's Moshimo-Box for the world to have real magic and sorcery. This doesn't go as he'd hoped, of course, and Nobita must navigate the strangely-bureaucratic magical world he'd made while also learning to conjure on his own in preparation for an attack by the underground-dwelling Demon World.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Little Star Wars
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙小戦争
parts.overview: As Nobita, Gian, Shizuka, and Suneo are making their own space movie, a fleeing bug-sized alien president makes his way to Earth, and needs the help of the kids and Doraemon to stop an oppressive dictatorship threatening his democracy.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Steel Troops
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と鉄人兵団
parts.overview: Doraemon and Nobita decide to build a perfect toy robot. However, their creation turns out to be a little more uncanny than an object of appreciation and wonder.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Birth of Japan
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の日本誕生
parts.overview: Nobita, thinking of running away from home, travels back in time with Doraemon and his pals to prehistoric Japan. However, a time paradox causes prehistoric boy Kukul to land in the modern day, so it's up to Doraemon and the rest to help the boy get back to the past while also defeating the mysterious shaman king, Giga-Zombie.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Three Visionary Swordsmen
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と夢幻三剣士
parts.overview: Nobita is exhausted from having constant nightmares and pleads Doraemon to arrange a dream machine that will enable him to dream of anything he wishes for. As Nobita dreams of him and his friends in the roles of gallant musketeers, the dream world starts to break down due to a dark force, and Nobita will have to put his fantasy to the test and become a hero, both in the real world and imagined.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Diary on the Creation of the World
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の創世日記
parts.overview: To help him with his summer vacation project, Doraemon gives Nobita a kit which allows him to create a new world. The duo and their friends then go on a journey to witness the evolution of life.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Space Heroes
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙英雄記
parts.overview: Nobita and friends decide to make a movie inspired by the space adventures of their heroes, but their fiction turns into a reality.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Birth of Japan
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の日本誕生
parts.overview: Doraemon and his friends travel to ancient Japan where they meet Kukuru. When Kukuru tells them that his tribe has been enslaved by Gigazombie, Doraemon decides to help him.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure in the Antarctic Kachi Kochi
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の南極カチコチ大冒険
parts.overview: Doraemon and Nobita discover a mysterious golden ring far beneath the ice in Antarctica, leading them to uncover an ancient, ruined city.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Treasure Island
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宝島
parts.overview: Upon hearing about the story of Treasure Island, Nobita dreams of discovering and exploring his own treasure island, despite the fact all of the Earth has been mapped already.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Chronicle of the Moon Exploration
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の月面探査記
parts.overview: After being mocked for believing that rabbits live on the Moon, Nobita uses one of Doraemon’s gadgets to create a hidden lunar kingdom. Accompanied by a mysterious new classmate named Luca, Nobita and his friends travel to the Moon’s far side, where they discover children with extraordinary powers and become drawn into a dangerous conflict that reaches far beyond Earth.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Tin Labyrinth
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とブリキの迷宮
parts.overview: Nobita and his friends find a portal to a mysterious resort filled with metal buildings. They soon discover that the person who opened the portal for them has an ulterior motive.

parts.title: Doraemon: Nobita's New Dinosaur
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の新恐竜
parts.overview: Nobita accidentally finds a fossil dinosaur egg mixed with rocks in the dinosaur fossil exhibition site that he had visited before. He returns it to its original state with the 'time blanket'.

parts.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Little Star Wars 2021
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙小戦争 2021
parts.overview: During summer vacation Nobita picks up a small rocket containing Papi, a palm-sized alien president escaping rebels on his home planet Pirika.

parts.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Sky Utopia
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と空の理想郷
parts.overview: Doraemon, Nobita and his friends go to find Utopia, a perfect land in the sky where everyone lives with happiness, using an airship having a time warp function.

parts.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Earth Symphony
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の地球交響楽
parts.overview: When a malevolent entity intent on eradicating music from the world surfaces, Nobita and his friends must unite with supernatural companions to safeguard the planet.

parts.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Art World Tales
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の絵世界物語
parts.overview: Nobita and Doraemon enter the world in a European Renaissance painting, but run into trouble as they hop from piece to piece in search of a malevolent time traveler who wishes to recreate the extinct pigment of "Artoria Blue".

parts.title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の海底鬼岩城
parts.overview: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

parts.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam-Powered Time Machine
parts.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の蒸気時間車
parts.overview: Nobita and his friends time-travel to 19th-century Victorian London.
